entities.name: Masumi Itō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Masumi Itō  is a Japanese singer and composer from Ibaraki prefecture in Japan. Itō has composed the soundtracks to many anime television shows and is part of the bands Oranges & Lemons and Heart of Air.
